text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Please, no need to apologize. I know firsthand
just how hard this game is.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: When you said you'd take it for me, Trainer... I was really happy.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"So, the results don't matter—your
kindness alone was more than enough."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much
for working so hard for my sake."
It ended in a disappointing result...
